factsheet.heading: The Home
paragraphs: 63C Richmond Avenue is a flat in the Barnsbury Conservation Area that has been reconfigured for a young family. The previous layout left the kitchen stranded in a cramped, pokey room at the rear, so the project brings it forward into the main front room and reworks the plan around how the family actually lives, adding a new WC and a nursery for the new arrival.

The heart of the project is a bespoke, joinery-led approach in which built-in cabinetry does the heavy lifting. The kitchen in particular is designed to disappear: treated as a piece of furniture in the living space rather than dominating it. The result is a compact period flat that gains storage, function and a sense of calm without losing its character.

factsheet.heading: Fynn
paragraphs: Fynn specialises in sustainable architecture and interior design for homes in Islington, London.
As architects with expertise in Islington’s heritage and listed buildings, we create architectural designs to transform your home while respecting its unique character.

We aim to create homes that combine heritage, aesthetics, functionality, and sustainability. Fynn provides architectural services covering all RIBA stages, from securing planning permission in Islington to technical design and project management.
We are an RIBA Chartered Practice and are listed on the RIBA Conservation Register.
